Sinterklaas in Amsterdam this week

16 – 22 Nov · 4 events

Sinterklaas shows, parties, workshops and family afternoons in the run-up to 5 December. Most are aimed at young children and their parents, and some are a nice introduction for anyone new to this Dutch tradition. The list is refreshed every week until the season ends. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

Showing today onwards

  1. Put out your shoe for Sinterklaas at Amstel1

    Sinterklaas · Kids & Family · Workshops

    When
    Sat 21 & Sun 22 Nov, 13:00–16:00
    Where
    De Lichtstraat, Amstel1, Waterlooplein 4C, Amsterdam (Waterlooplein, Centrum)
    Price
    Free
    Organiser
    Amstel1

    Children decorate a shoe (bring one or make one with glitter and fabric) and leave it in the Lichtstraat in case Sinterklaas fills it. All ages.

    Details and tickets for Put out your shoe for Sinterklaas at Amstel1 (organiser's site)

  2. Sint & Piet at Gelderlandplein

    Sinterklaas · Kids & Family · Music

    When
    Sat 21 & Sun 22 Nov, 12:30–16:30
    Where
    Winkelcentrum Gelderlandplein, Van Leijenberghlaan 43, Amsterdam (Buitenveldert, Zuid)
    Price
    Free
    Organiser
    Winkelcentrum Gelderlandplein

    Saturday is the festive Sinterklaas arrival at Gelderlandplein, with a Pietenband and acrobat Pieten; on Sunday, Sint and Piet are back with treats for children.

    Details and tickets for Sint & Piet at Gelderlandplein (organiser's site)

  3. Feest op zondag: Sinterklaas at Wereldmuseum

    Sinterklaas · Kids & Family · Workshops · Regular

    When
    Sun 22 Nov (also 29 Nov & 6 Dec), 12:00–16:00 (drop-in until 15:30)
    Where
    Feestwinkel, Wereldmuseum Amsterdam, Linnaeusstraat 2, Amsterdam (Oost)
    Price
    Free with museum admission
    Organiser
    Wereldmuseum Amsterdam

    The museum's weekly Sunday party (ages 6+) takes a Sinterklaas theme this month: stories about how the tradition has changed, then make your own Bonne Bonne Bon. Also on 29 Nov and 6 Dec.

    Details and tickets for Feest op zondag: Sinterklaas at Wereldmuseum (organiser's site)

  4. Sinterklaas and the Pietenband at Boven 't Y

    Sinterklaas · Kids & Family · Music

    When
    Sun 22 Nov, 12:30–16:00
    Where
    Winkelcentrum Boven 't Y, Buikslotermeerplein 229, Amsterdam (Buikslotermeer, Noord)
    Price
    Free
    Organiser
    Winkelcentrum Boven 't Y

    Sinterklaas visits shopping centre Boven 't Y with his Pietenband, plus bicycle Pieten and sweet-throwing Pieten, for a festive afternoon. Just come along.
